website_url.description: The site under audit, already normalized by the caller (scheme + host, e.g. https://example.com).

brand_name.description: The name the brand goes by. Absent, derive it from the homepage title or the domain and say so in caveats.

brand_description.description: How the brand describes itself, in its own words. The reference for "same company" — search results and generated answers that describe something else are a different entity, not coverage.

audit_date.description: ISO date the audit is for, used in the report headline. Absent, omit the date rather than guess it.

pages.description: What the caller's page-extraction step returned — one entry per URL it ATTEMPTED, including failures. Expected attempts are the homepage, /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml, and two to five key pages (about, FAQ, recent posts).

content.description: Extracted page text (markdown or plain). Rendered text, not raw HTML.

failed.description: True when the extraction step could not retrieve this URL.

error.description: The extraction step's failure reason, verbatim.

search_results.description: What the caller's web-search step returned — one entry per query it ran (brand + category, and a question a buyer would ask).

answer.description: The search provider's generated answer, when it returned one.

keywords.description: Optional terms or questions the site should answer. Each gets an on-site and in-search coverage verdict. Run the same list against a competitor's site to compare.

summary_max_chars.description: Hard cap for summary_markdown. Defaults to 3800, which fits a Slack message with room to spare.
